scope: Structured technical claims and derived experience profiles for representative Second World War and early Cold War armored vehicles.
notes: M4 family claims preserve M4A2E8 and M4A4 Firefly configurations separately.
T-34 Model 1940 and Panther family records receive independent museum sources and source_checked review status.
Type 59 claims describe the baseline vehicle and exclude later upgrade packages.
Historical qualitative design statements are used only when the source explicitly supports them.
